data.title: 伊内丝 · 回程的路灯
data.description: 夜里街上人很少。她走在靠外的一侧，听完你说的事后只答了一句“我知道了”，脚步却放慢了些。
data.action: 沿着路灯下的人行道慢行
data.promptProse: Strolling along a quiet urban sidewalk late at night, Ines walks with a steady, graceful pace under the warm, rhythmic glow of glowing streetlights. The damp, dark asphalt of the street reflects the amber halos of the lights, while quiet city storefronts, locked bicycle racks, and the distant, twinkling city skyline create a calm, atmospheric nighttime mood.
